newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 13.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on September 13:
WASHINGTON - The United States sent more planes, ships and anti-missile defense batteries to prepare for possible air strikes against Iraq.
WASHINGTON - Senate opponents forced a delay of ratification of a global treaty to ban poison gas weapons.
WASHINGTON - Clinton backers often dislike what he does, but ignore his flaws.
WASHINGTON - Leonard Slatkin took over the National Symphony Orchestra.
WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Board officials face a puzzling economy when they meet on September 24 to decide whether to raise interest rates.
WASHINGTON - A national commission decried the state of teacher training and treatment.
